Aside from this, on the workflow side, we usually want PRs with a self-contained change like this to only contain one commit, so that our Git history stays readable and useful (that's also why we require explicit commit messages so that we can see what a commit does at a glance - you already improved it, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#format-your-commit-messages-with-readability-in-mind) for more details for future contributions). review_comments:
This change preserves what was the current behavior, but I'm not sure that it's correct.

The intent of this code's author was that in the error case, `arr[i + max]` should be `Variant()`, not a non-numeral value. So this is probably what needs to be changed (with an `else` instead of removing the assignment).

CC @simpuid who wrote that code, and @Faless who reviewed.
Yeah, that seems to be the case. It slipped my review. Could also be `arr[i + max] = 0` instead of `Variant()`.

[This](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/5707c5d0ff67f3fa3a20ff7b30bdcd1f176b0f4b/editor/debugger/script_editor_debugger.cpp#L430) is the part where we are getting the `float` back from `Variant`
@Faless Should we add an extra check there too?
Sorry, I missed this comment, yes, the cast should be automatic and not fail, but better be safe, so I would add the check (setting the value to 0 is not `is_num`).
